selected.description: Selected number type to configure emergency call back.

phoneNumber.description: The callback phone number that is associated with the direct line.

effectiveLevel.description: The source from which the emergency calling line ID (CLID) is selected for an actual emergency call, applying fallback rules as necessary.

effectiveValue.description: The field contains the valid ECBN number at the location level, or the user's main number if valid, defaulting to the location's main number if both are unavailable.

quality.description: Used to represent whether a number is a recommended ECBN.

directLineInfo.description: Data relevant to the ECBN for this user/location/virtual line/hunt group.

phoneNumber.description: The callback phone number that is associated with the location's ECBN configuration.

firstName.description: First name for the location. This field will be populated with group name when the `effectiveLevel` is `LOCATION_ECBN` or `LOCATION_NUMBER`.

lastName.description: This field contains the location member's last name when the `effectiveLevel` is `LOCATION_ECBN`, the location is using a location member number, and the selected member is a user. This field will always return "." when the `effectiveLevel` is `LOCATION_ECBN`, the location is using the location member number, and the selected member is a place.

effectiveValue.description: Contains the location-level emergency callback number if valid. If not, contains the user's main number if valid.

locationECBNInfo.description: Data relevant to the user/place/virtual line/hunt group selected for ECBN for this location.

phoneNumber.description: A unique identifier for the location member's PSTN phone number.

firstName.description: First name for the location member.

lastName.description: Last name for the location member. This field will always return "." when `effectiveLevel` is `DIRECT_LINE` or `LOCATION_MEMBER_NUMBER`, and the selected member is a place.

memberId.description: Member ID of user/place/virtual line/hunt group within the location.
